nom: TATCHA The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder

avis.texte: I agree with the reviewer that said there's nothing like it. It took me a couple tries to get the right amount but once I did, I love it. It's my favorite cleanser. So creamy yet exfoliating. Try it & give it a couple tries to get it right.

avis.titre: I have used this product for years…
avis.texte: This is the best enzyme powder on the market! I've used it for years, keeps my skin looking healthy, smooth & glowing…

I received this as a gift a few years ago and have since continued to repurchase. It is wonderful on my sensitive skin. I battle a light case of eczema and need gentle but consistent exfoliation. This product fits the bill well. I use it every other evening with great results. My skin is smooth and glowing. I dampen the granules and work them gently into my wet face. The grains buff my skin and then melt down into a soft foam. I would highly recommend this product.
This product dried my skin out sooo bad and barely has anything for exfoliating. It's literally an overpriced paste. Dermalogica milkfoliant is better.

While looking for a new foundation, an associate at the local Ulta asked what I didn't like about my current foundation. I wasn't sure but thought I needed a bit more "glow" to my skin. Further conversation ensued and she ended up suggesting I try a couple of different things, that did not include looking for yet another foundation. First and foremost, the associate touted the benefits of the Rice Polish Powder. I had not used a product like it before so thought, why not. Turns out, I love this stuff! While a little pricey, you use a tiny amount of product so it will last. It feels amazing- softens by buffing but doesn't dry out the skin. I now plan on trying the whole line by Tatcha.

The reason I only gave 4 out of five stars is because there is a design flaw in the container causing way too much product to dump out at once. To solve this angle the container at a side angle or have somewhere else to dump the excess that comes out.
This rice polish is wonderful makes the skin look so soft and smooth very clean. I love it, use it every day.
This product has made such a change in my skin. It's so smooth and clear. I will definitely purchase again.

avis.titre: The best exfoliation product out there
avis.texte: This is hands down, the BEST product to exfoliate your face. It's a little pricey, but you only need a little bit of product and you only use it once per week, so it will last a long time. Plus, it completely removes dead skin and imperfections - you can literally IMMEDIATELY feel the difference in your skin. You only need it for 10-20 seconds. It doesnt feel harsh like other exfoliants either, you mix some powder with water and it becomes a foamy texture.
I love this product. I struggled to find a light exfoliator for my skin and this it! Not harsh at all and i noticed a difference literally after the first use.

This is my first time trying the Tatcha Rice Polish and I am blown away The texture of my skin changed immediately it seemed to smooth everything out I also suffer from the occasional blemish and have yet to have one since using the polish A few things to keep in mind -This is NOT a cleanser and is to be used after your cleaning routine -Use this product on an already wet face This is the perfect amount of exfoliation Its strong enough to see results immediately but gentle enough that I can use it morning and night
